source: Existing standard Protomaps20261020/Mapzen201x201/6m Observatory extract reused. Uncovered south entry approach internal[0,6.95], datum47.73069916666667m; floor0.2m above control. Closed footing unions mapped floor with reconstructed circular body and north/south portals. Only the occupied mapped footprint cuts ground; retain original approaches/provider, all independent buildings, roads and water. Approximate native exterior fit reviewed on the original hill; boundary grade -0.46..+0.002m leaves a modest base. Exact historic thresholds, steps and accessibility remain approximate.
